name: AGNITE NASA FIRMS Thermal Recurrence Model
task: Predict another FIRMS thermal detection in the same spatial cell within 24h, 48h, or 7d; not a confirmed-fire forecast.
trainingSource: No real historical training artifact has been generated yet.
limitations: Run scripts/train-firms-recurrence-model.py on historical NASA FIRMS CSV exports to create a validated artifact.
Until then, AGNITE uses the transparent heuristic future-risk simulation.
